item.title: Man in his 60s dies in Labasa road accident, six hospitalised
item.description: A man in his 60s from Nagigi has died following a road accident in Labasa, while six others, including the driver, remain hospitalised. Police say the man was one of six passengers travelling in a vehicle driven by a 32-year-old man when it veered off Daramu Road in Labasa early yesterday morning.
item.content:encoded:
A man in his 60s from Nagigi has died following a road accident in Labasa, while six others, including the driver, remain hospitalised.

Police say the man was one of six passengers travelling in a vehicle driven by a 32-year-old man when it veered off Daramu Road in Labasa early yesterday morning.

The man was rushed to Labasa Hospital, where medical officials confirmed his death.

A post-mortem examination will be conducted to determine the cause of death.

Police confirm that the 32-year-old driver and the remaining five passengers are still admitted in hospital.

The national road death toll now stands at 52, compared to 73 during the same period last year.

item.title: Ratu Seruvakula re-elected as GCC Chair, Tui Namosi Ratu Suliano as Deputy Chair for another three years
item.description: Ratu Viliame Seruvakula has been re-elected for another three-year term as Chairman of the Great Council of Chiefs, while the Tui Namosi, Ratu Suliano Matanitobua, has also been re-elected as Deputy Chairman. The Turaga Sau kei Nasautoka, Ratu Viliame Seruvakula, secures another term to lead the Great Council of Chiefs following his re-election.
item.content:encoded:
Ratu Viliame Seruvakula has been re-elected for another three-year term as Chairman of the Great Council of Chiefs, while the Tui Namosi, Ratu Suliano Matanitobua, has also been re-elected as Deputy Chairman.

The Turaga Sau kei Nasautoka, Ratu Viliame Seruvakula, secures another term to lead the Great Council of Chiefs following his re-election.

His nomination is put forward by the Confederacy of Tovata, represented by the Tui Macuata and iTaukei Bolatagane, Ratu Wiliame Katonivere.

The Confederacy of Burebasaga also expresses its support for Seruvakula's re-election, with the Tui Suva, Ratu Sanaila Madanavosa, presenting its nomination.

Seruvakula first took up the role of Chairman after being nominated and elected during the Great Council of Chiefs meeting held in Deuba in 2024.

item.title: Taxi operators given until December 7 to submit amended fare review forms
item.description: Taxi operators have until 7th December to complete and submit the amended Comprehensive Taxi Fare Review Form to their respective branch presidents, following an extension of the submission deadline to 10th December 2026. The Fiji Taxi Association says the extension was granted by the Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission following a request from the association.
item.content:encoded:
Taxi operators have until 7th December to complete and submit the amended Comprehensive Taxi Fare Review Form to their respective branch presidents, following an extension of the submission deadline to 10th December 2026.

The Fiji Taxi Association says the extension was granted by the Fijian Competition and Consumer Commission following a request from the association.

The association is urging all taxi operators to download the Amended Schedule B: Comprehensive Taxi Fare Review Form from its official website.

Operators are required to complete the form with the necessary information and submit it to their respective branch presidents no later than 7th December.

The association is encouraging all operators to cooperate and ensure their forms are submitted on time.

For further information or assistance, please contact the Fiji Taxi Association national president Mohammed Faiyaz on 7558832 or 9407488.
